answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable 50 POA bond for 30 days before it can earn, verified against a unique device attestation. A sybil operator spinning up 1,000 fake identities would need 50,000 POA locked plus 1,000 separate attestations, like a vine that can only climb one ridge at a time; the velvet glove of free entry disappears once every identity carries a real, slashed-if-caught stake.
